amendments.authority: OWNER DECISION 2026-11-20 (decision 19): "LSLOT-03 and LSLOT-06 case designs are amended: drop or replace each impossible variant with the reviewer's recorded reason (LSLOT-03: unselectable `fs.write`; the input-only variant no checked candidate can have; the impossible under-declare variant. LSLOT-06: case-level `guest_requests: 0` contradicting its accepted valid-borrow variant; serialize/forge variants with no operations by design), record them as owner-approved amendments, and run both through the reviewed gate." Only the items this decision names are listed here.

LIVE-02.decision: OWNER DECISION 2026-11-20 (decision 21a, verbatim): "Decision 21's script ['20 twice swap run'] was based on a wrong derivation: from the retained old Program P it yields [25] (`run` consumes 24 and the old capture adds 1), not the case's unchanged expected stack [24, 21] (the integrator's question also misquoted that stack as [21, 22], LIVE-01's). The integrator, under the owner's delegation, replaces decision 21's script with ["20 swap run 20 twice swap"]: [P] -> 20 -> [P,20] -> swap -> [20,P] -> run (old capture, +1) -> [21] -> 20 -> [21,20] -> twice (rebuilt dependent, +4) -> [21,24] -> swap -> [24,21]. Nothing else in the case changes; LIVE-02 is promoted only if a fresh receipt observes exactly [24, 21] and every other expected field."

limitations: This receipt executes behavior; it is not a proof. Every promoted case keeps `proof: open`.
LSLOT-05 and LSLOT-08 are not executed here: their positive selected-target and exact replay outcomes wait on runtime template identity (P-ID-03/P-ID-04).
LSLOT-04 and LSLOT-07 remain refused on evidence-carrying publication, the same capability LSLOT-05 waits for; their other fields are recorded.
`verification/live-slot-current-source/gate.mjs` and `verification/live-update-corpus` are historical: they replay only at their recorded source states and are not re-run here.
